title: SDE : Scale-Difference Evolution Knowledge Distillation

problem.claim: Efficient model compression and cross-architecture learning require effective logit-based knowledge distillation.

gap.claim: Conventional knowledge distillation typically uses static, single-scale logit alignment and overlooks semantic evolution in cross-scale prediction transitions.

contributions.claim: SDE models differences between multi-scale logits to capture transitions from local features to global semantics.

SDE separates scale differences into Category-Dominant Difference and Relational Structure Difference modules, using Top-K attention for core-category evidence fluctuations and preserving inter-class topological evolution.

stated_novelty.claim: The authors propose Scale-Difference Evolution distillation as a structure-aware alternative to traditional prediction imitation.

author_reported_evidence.claim: The authors report consistent gains over state-of-the-art methods on CIFAR-100, Tiny-ImageNet-200, CUB-200, and Stanford Cars.
The authors report an 8.10% accuracy boost on the CUB-200 fine-grained benchmark.

narrative_sequence.summary: Logit-based knowledge distillation supports efficient model compression and cross-architecture learning.
Static single-scale logit alignment overlooks semantic evolution in cross-scale prediction transitions.
SDE introduces structure-aware modeling of multi-scale logit differences to represent transitions from local features to global semantics.
CDD and RSD decouple scale differences to improve the distillation signal-to-noise ratio while modeling category evidence and relational topology.
The authors report broad benchmark gains, including an 8.10% CUB-200 accuracy boost.

unknowns: The abstract does not specify the teacher and student architectures, training objectives, hyperparameters, or baseline configurations.
The abstract does not provide results for individual datasets beyond the reported CUB-200 accuracy boost.
